original_plan: H1 prioritized a highly central SVMP-VWF/ADAMTS13 axis and SVSP-coagulation axis; H2 prioritized complement and endothelial enrichment. The plan was timestamped but not prospectively registered.
implemented_analysis: H1/H2 were reformulated after data inspection around the observed coagulation architecture and layered host-response hypotheses; no TMA discriminator was claimed.
timing_trigger: Post hoc, after inspection of the curated edges and axis coverage.
inference_consequence: The output is an exploratory, auditable mechanism map, not a confirmatory test of the initial hypotheses.

original_plan: Selected toxin-target interfaces were hypothesized to be tractable by batimastat/marimastat-type inhibitors.
implemented_analysis: Structural outputs were restricted to molecular context; inhibitor efficacy, selectivity and physiological stability were not inferred.
timing_trigger: Post hoc, after structural-control and identity review.
inference_consequence: Docking scores cannot upgrade a literature edge or establish therapeutic utility.

original_plan: CD-HIT at 90% identity with removal of sequences shorter than 30 amino acids.
implemented_analysis: A custom length-seeded greedy 90%-identity procedure was used and benchmarked against usearch v11.0.667 cluster_fast over all 1,953 sequence pairs.
inference_consequence: The procedure is named accurately; marginal merge decisions are exposed rather than described as CD-HIT output.

original_plan: Curated evidence was ranked above database-predicted and homology-inferred evidence.
implemented_analysis: All 447 rows were reclassified; 33 of 49 initially literature-labelled rows had row-specific primary-literature support. STRING, annotation-only, family-level and similarity channels were separated.
inference_consequence: Primary conclusions use 33 interactions across 15 host targets; other channels remain annotation context.

original_plan: The edge table retained toxin and subunit records.
implemented_analysis: RVV-X light and heavy chains were treated as components of one toxin complex; duplicate russelysin/daborhagin-K naming was flagged.
inference_consequence: Factor X convergence is reported as six edges from four independent toxin entities, avoiding subunit pseudoreplication.

original_plan: Hub genes were to be defined by cytoHubba MCC/Degree/EPC Top-20 intersection and MCODE modules.
implemented_analysis: The 54-node/321-edge STRING layer was analysed descriptively with NetworkX reimplementations of Degree, MCC and EPC; tied EPC values were retained and no robustness-based causal ranking was used.
timing_trigger: Post hoc topology and evidence-function review.
inference_consequence: The expanded network supplies context rather than independent validation or causal hub claims.

original_plan: GO/KEGG/Reactome enrichment was planned with BH correction, without the final ascertainment-matched background design.
implemented_analysis: Seven input groups were tested against backgrounds matched to their sampling frames; G2 was designated primary and G1 supporting.
inference_consequence: G2 uses the 1,042-gene core background; G1 separately uses 16,662 annotated genes.

original_plan: Enrichment significance was to be assessed using adjusted overlap tests.
implemented_analysis: Ten-thousand equally sized background permutations, leave-one-source-out reconstruction, no-GeneCards analyses and g:Profiler custom-background comparisons were added.
timing_trigger: Post hoc sensitivity review on 2026-11-06; permutation seed 20261106.
inference_consequence: Random-background behaviour, source dependence, axis dependence and cross-platform analytical consistency are reported separately.

original_plan: The locked protocol specified limma with BH adjustment.
implemented_analysis: The earlier gene-wise Welch implementation was replaced by protocol-concordant classical limma; trend-plus-robust and quantile-normalization sensitivity analyses were added.
inference_consequence: Primary analyses report 43 and 75 BH-significant genes; the earlier zero-significant-gene result is not carried forward.

original_plan: HAVCR1 was included among prespecified renal-response molecules and expression intersections were considered as supporting evidence.
implemented_analysis: Surrogate datasets were interpreted as endothelial and inflammatory-myotoxic context; HAVCR1 was removed from renal and translational interpretation because it was non-significant in both limma variants.
timing_trigger: After model-identity review and limma reanalysis.
inference_consequence: No patient-level TMA validation or HAVCR1-centered kidney-injury claim is made.

original_plan: P4 used a file labelled H_GP1BA_1M10_A.pdb for snaclec-GP1BA docking.
implemented_analysis: Raw PDB annotation shows 1M10 chain A is VWF A1 and chain B is GP1BA. P4 was withdrawn and excluded from structural support.
inference_consequence: No P4 pose, cluster or interface descriptor is used as supportive evidence.

original_plan: P6 was described as Kunitz-plasmin docking using 1QRZ.
implemented_analysis: Raw PDB annotation identifies 1QRZ as the plasminogen catalytic domain, not activated plasmin. P6 was restricted to orientation-level context.
inference_consequence: The literature plasmin-inhibition edge is not structurally upgraded by a plasminogen model.

original_plan: The initial plan preferred receptor structures at resolution <= 3.0 Å.
implemented_analysis: Identity, chain assignment, activation state, structural coverage and template dependence were audited explicitly. Contextual use retained 7KVE (3.3 Å), 1M10 (3.1 Å) and 3V2A (3.2 Å) with their limitations recorded; P4 was subsequently withdrawn for receptor-chain misidentification.
inference_consequence: Resolution alone was not treated as evidence of model validity; structural coverage and biological state determine the permitted interpretation.

original_plan: Docking thresholds were initially treated as structural support criteria.
implemented_analysis: P1 was limited to orientation-level context; P3 to a proxy-site pose because the fibrinogen alpha-C region is not covered; P7 was labelled template-dependent with ligand RMSD 21.95 Å.
timing_trigger: Joint review of activation state, structural coverage and template dependence.
inference_consequence: Scores and interface descriptors are pose properties, not independent demonstrations of binding or stability.
